crossRefs.note: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
“He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

translations.web: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
translations.bsb: For whoever is not against us is for us.
translations.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.
translations.asv: For he that is not against us is for us.
